faq.how_accept_order: How do I accept an order?
faq.how_accept_order_answer: When a new order comes in, you'll receive a notification. Tap on the order card to view details, then slide the 'Accept Order' button to confirm.
faq.cancel_order: Can I cancel an order after accepting?
faq.cancel_order_answer: You can cancel an order before pickup by contacting support. Note that frequent cancellations may affect your rating.
faq.order_issues: What if I have issues with an order?
faq.order_issues_answer: Contact the customer first using the chat or call buttons. If the issue persists, reach out to support through the app.
faq.when_paid_answer: Earnings are processed weekly. You'll receive your payout every Monday for the previous week's deliveries.
faq.withdraw_earnings: How do I withdraw my earnings?
faq.withdraw_earnings_answer: Go to the Earnings tab and tap 'Withdraw Funds'. Enter the amount and select your payment method. Withdrawals are processed within 1-2 business days.
faq.earnings_calculation_answer: Your earnings include the base delivery fee, distance bonus, and any tips from customers. You can see the breakdown for each delivery.
faq.update_vehicle: How do I update my vehicle information?
faq.update_vehicle_answer: Go to Settings > Vehicle Information > Edit. Update your details and save. Some changes may require verification.
faq.vehicle_requirements_answer: Your vehicle must be in good working condition, properly insured, and meet local regulations. Specific requirements vary by vehicle type.
faq.reset_password: How do I reset my password?
faq.reset_password_answer: On the login screen, tap 'Forgot Password?' and enter your email. You'll receive a link to create a new password.
faq.update_profile: How do I update my profile?
faq.update_profile_answer: Go to Settings > Personal Information > Edit. Update your details and save your changes.
faq.delete_account: How do I delete my account?
faq.delete_account_answer: Go to Settings > Security > Delete Account. Note that this action is permanent and cannot be undone.
